mount-gambier-6.name: Ewens Ponds
mount-gambier-6.bio: Three spring-fed limestone ponds linked by shallow channels, open to permit-holding snorkellers and divers except in spring.

Spot stays free/open since the permit is optional for a walk-only visit.
